title: Door, Window and Useful Emptiness — Taoist Negative-Space Comparator
status: comparative philosophy + project relation; no transmission claim
purpose: Preserve a useful comparison already present in the repository's Tao Te Ching text: wheel hub, vessel hollow and room openings derive function partly from empty/available space. Compare this with Tim's Door/Frame/Window architecture while keeping Taoist textual context and Potatoverse interpretation distinct.

source_text_context.work: Tao Te Ching / Daodejing, chapter 11 in the repository's English text
structure: spokes converge on an empty hub and wheel-use depends on the central opening
clay makes a vessel but its hollow interior makes containment/use possible
doors and windows are openings in walls and their open space helps make a room usable
source_text_context.boundary: Translation wording varies, and the chapter is not a hidden Potatoverse Door doctrine. The comparison is functional/philosophical only.

project_comparison.door: A wall separates; an opening makes selective passage possible.
project_comparison.window: An opening can admit light/view without admitting every carrier.
project_comparison.frame: Solid boundary gives the opening shape; usefulness depends on both boundary and void.
project_comparison.wheel: The center/hub need not be a filled object; the useful axle-space may be a structured absence.
project_comparison.vessel: Container function depends on interior capacity rather than material shell alone.
project_comparison.house: House requires walls for structure and openings for circulation/access.
project_comparison.new_relation: Door/Window and House/Shell become co-dependent opposites: boundary creates distinguishable inside/outside; opening creates controlled relation between them.

mathematical_neighbors.domain_and_hole: Let Omega be a bounded domain and A subset partial Omega an opening. Geometry is carried by both the material/boundary set and the excluded/open set.
mathematical_neighbors.aperture_measure: For a simple planar wall, openness fraction f_A=measure(A)/measure(partial Omega_relevant) can quantify one geometric aspect of opening, but function still depends on carrier and boundary conditions.
mathematical_neighbors.conductance_neighbor: A small opening can dominate transfer between otherwise separated regions; effective conductance/permeability depends on aperture geometry and the transported carrier.
mathematical_neighbors.topology_neighbor: Creating/removing an opening can change connectivity of an accessible region or configuration graph without adding a new solid object.
mathematical_neighbors.warning: These are mathematical analogies; Daoist wu/nonbeing/usefulness should not be reduced to one engineering variable.

new_project_laws: Useful-Void Law: function can depend on a structured absence/opening rather than an added object.
Boundary-Opening Complementarity: a Door needs enough boundary to distinguish regions and enough opening to relate them; pure wall and pure openness are different failures for many functions.
Carrier-Specific Void Law: an opening is not equally open to all carriers—glass can function as optical Window while remaining mechanical Wall.
Center-as-Capacity Law: the significance of a center may lie in what it can receive, transmit or organize rather than how much material occupies it.
